title: Paloma Retail pilot outreach scratchpad
content:
Top-level goal:
- Book a 30-min pilot intro with Paloma product/data folks to (1) validate retrieval + rerank use case, (2) surface a low-risk private deployment path (VPC or Dedicated), (3) scope success metrics for a 6-week PoC.

Quick account notes (what I could find):
- Company: Paloma Retail (mid-market, omnichannel apparel + home goods). HQ SF, ~1.1k employees.
- Recent news: Series D Q3 2024; launched mobile personalization engine late 2024.
- Tech org: Head of Product Ops = Nora Castillo (LinkedIn shows prev at Stitch); CTO = Rajesh Menon; Data Lead / Head of Search = Marco Alvarez (likely primary DM for infra decisions).
- Current stack: ElasticSearch for product search, user events -> Snowflake, batch ML features (SageMaker references in job postings).
- Pain signals: job posting for "search relevance engineer" (hiring), customer support threads complaining about "bad search for long-tail SKUs", PRs about mobile conversion dips.
- Likely constraints: cost sensitivity (mid-market), engineering bandwidth, and security/PII rules for loyalty data.

Hypothesis / where Redwood fits:
- Use case: Improve on-site search + facet-aware ranking using reranker + embeddings to capture natural language user queries and product descriptions.
- Value props to lead with: 20–40% GTM improvement in long-tail conversions (qualitative), consistent latency for interactive search (p99 under X ms), and ability to host inference inside their VPC (data never leaves). Emphasize easy fallbacks (hosted -> dedicated -> private) for incremental risk reduction.

Key stakeholders to call out in outreach:
- Marco Alvarez, Head of Search / Relevance (main DM).
- Nora Castillo, Head of Product Ops (budget + rollout).
- Rajesh Menon, CTO (final sign-off on private infra).
- Eng leads for search / infra: "Search Team" (2–3 ICs, often own ES cluster).

Objections we should be ready for + suggested answers:
- "We already use Elastic / our own models": Acknowledge; position Redwood as an augmentation path — bring fast rerank/embeddings layer in front of ES (prefix caching to preserve cost). Offer a small-footprint pilot using existing logs to show delta.
- "Concerned about PII/customer data leaving our network": Highlight Redwood Private (VPC) and Dedicated options; describe KMS integration and audit logs. Offer an architecture diagram for on-prem sandbox.
- "Cost": Present modeled TCO for a 6-week pilot (ingest + evaluation tokens + one small dedicated node) and comparative numbers showing potential cost per incremental conversion. Share Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) to reduce runtime costs.
- "Latency for search is critical": We'll propose SLA targets for the pilot (p95 < 150ms for rerank, streaming offload where needed). Bring an SRE reference case.

Outbound email (cold -> warm follow-up) draft (short):
Subject: Quick pilot idea to cut Paloma search "no results" and boost long-tail conversions
Hi Marco —
I’m Maya on the partner team at Redwood Inference. We work with product/search teams at mid-market retailers to plug a light-weight embeddings + reranker layer in front of ES, so long-tail queries return relevant items faster and conversions improve.

Small ask: 30 minutes to walk through the idea and see whether a 4–6 week pilot (we host in your VPC or on a small Dedicated node) could show signal on your logs. If helpful I can share a one-page pilot plan and cost estimate up front.

If not you, who on your team owns search relevance?
Thanks,
Maya

Call script / discovery checklist (30 min):
- 0–3m: Quick intros, confirm attendees, set goal: whether a 6-week pilot can show measurable delta.
- 3–10m: Quick tech readout: current search stack, typical query volume, p95/p99 latency goals, where logs live, any privacy gating.
- 10–18m: Business KPIs: baseline conversion on search, key segments (mobile web vs app), target improvement, existing A/B cadence.
- 18–24m: Pilot scope: sample logs, evaluation queries, whether to use labeled relevance sets, success metric (lift in CTR/conv or NDCG).
- 24–28m: Ops: preferred deployment (VPC/Dedicated), estimated time to spin up, contacts for infra/security.
- 28–30m: Next steps + agree owner for pilot doc + date for kickoff call.

Data ask for pilot (minimal):
- 2 weeks sample of search query logs + click-throughs (anonymized), product catalog dump (csv), 2–3 example problem queries (user reports).
- Access: read-only Snowflake query or s3 dump. If they cannot share data, plan B: use synthetic profiles + public catalog subset to run a qualitative demo.

Rough pilot plan (6 weeks):
- Week 0: scoping + security review (VPC auth, KMS), ingest pipeline check.
- Week 1–2: offline eval (embed catalog + queries, rerank experiments) -> expected quick signal in NDCG/CTR.
- Week 3–4: small-scale live test (shadow or small % of traffic) on Dedicated or VPC. Telemetry into Redwood Console for cost/latency.
- Week 5–6: A/B analysis + roll/fallback plan + next-phase proposal.

Success metrics (examples):
- Lift in search click-through rate for long-tail queries: target +10–25% relative.
- Decrease in "no results" searches by X% (we’ll quantify after logs).
- p95 latency for rerank under 150–200ms; cost per conversion <= $Y (modeled).

Notes to self / tactical checklist:
- Prep a short architecture diagram: "ES + Redwood reranker" showing data flow & optional private deployment. Add KMS + audit logs box.
- Get ENG-2042 notes (linked) to show SRE playbook.
- Demo: build two examples using Paloma public catalog subset -> show before/after queries (long-tail jewelry SKU examples, fuzzy name matches).
- Ask Solutions Eng to prepare quick TCO sheet (cost for 6-week pilot + 3-month projection).
- Ask growth to pull recent PR/metrics about mobile conversion dip so outreach feels timely.

Follow-ups planned:
- Send email by EOD Mon (follow-up to Marco on LinkedIn after send).
- If no reply in 5 days, send a short case study of a similar retailer (anonymized) with delta numbers.
- Once we have a meeting, arrange 1:1 prep with Riley (SE) 24h before call; draft pilot doc v0 in Confluence before kickoff.

Open questions (to resolve pre-send):
- Which deployment will reduce friction fastest? (Dedicated vs VPC onboarding time). Need input from infra team (Liam).
- Who owns budget at Paloma — product or ecomm ops? If product ops, Nora is the right contact.

Quick snippets for LinkedIn + internal Slack outreach:
- LinkedIn snippet to Marco: "Hi Marco — saw your search relevance role hire. Small idea: Redwood helps reduce no-results and boost long-tail conversions with a light rerank layer that runs in-VPC. 30 min?"
- Slack to #solutions-eng: "Heads up — likely Paloma pilot. Need quick demo assets: before/after search examples + TCO calc. Ping Riley/Liam."

This doc is a living scratchpad — update with meeting notes and ticket refs. Keep outreach tone low-friction; emphasize small pilot and optional private hosting to move from cold to conversation quickly.

-- end scratchpad --
